description: Keyword search across roster names, summaries, and expanded report copy. The parameter is query (not q). This does not search articles or episodes. Optional market and layer filters. layer=beyond is Attic Beyond. Use attic_list_articles for the article archive.

layer.description: Optional layer filter. Omit to search the public index.

limit.description: How many hits to return. Default 8, max 20.

query.description: Keywords, at least 2 characters. Sent as the query parameter.

name: attic_search
title: Search Attic reports
